name: Gila Grande
flavour: Slow to anger. You have angered it.
art_prompt: a gigantic fat gila monster lizard boss, black and bright orange beaded scales in bold bands, a huge head with a wide toothy jaw and a small crown of bones on its head, hulking on four thick clawed legs, standing on the ground facing the viewer, its tail hidden behind its body and not visible, symmetrical body, no extra limbs
motion: lumbering in place, heavy and slow, the tail swinging, jaw opening
anim_negative: two tails, extra tail, extra limbs, extra heads
doc: Stage 2's boss: a lunge, a rain of red cactus spikes over a huge area round it (the custom attack cactus_rain: every circle lights at once, then it spews; stand in a gap), a burrow (it sinks out of sight, waits three seconds and erupts where the hero is heading, throwing him and the crowd), a ring of lizards (never specials). Pays two chests and seventy-five coins (pass 110: half of pass 70's 150).
